listing.name: Pacific Rim: The Video Game — Pacific Rim — Linux Recompilation (thefixinhixon)
listing.summary: The project reports Linux gameplay, DLC and saves, with fault and shared-memory fixes. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Pacific Rim: The Video Game Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Title 584112C1; own DLC optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the Linux AppImage or folder release to import your own Pacific Rim package. Windows is not a supported target at this stage.

warnings: The project reports Linux gameplay, DLC and saves, with fault and shared-memory fixes.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
